name: Custom Menu Music
description: Choose any audio file (.mp3, .ogg, .wav, .flac) to play on the main menu.

issues.info: Report bugs or request features on GitHub Issues.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable custom menu music.

custom-music-file.name: Audio File
custom-music-file.description: Select an audio file (.mp3, .ogg, .wav, .flac) from your computer.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Loop the song seamlessly when it finishes.

show-menu-button.name: Show Menu Button
show-menu-button.description: Show a shortcut button on the main menu bottom bar.

show-notification.name: Notify on Song Selection
show-notification.description: Show a notification with the song title when selecting or changing the audio file.

notify-on-menu-return.name: Notify on Menu Return
notify-on-menu-return.description: Show 'Now Playing' notification every time you return to the main menu from a level.
